{{Quote|Why... Why do you have my husband's face? I don't understand.|Connor Freeman's mother to Jango Fett|<ref name="BT2" />}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was married to a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Connor Freeman's father|deserter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and the mother of [[Connor Freeman]]. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], also the clone army's genetic template, was hired by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to track the deserter, Fett accepted the job and declined the additional information supplied by the Count. Fett cornered the deserter on his home on the planet [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] and then [[Death/Legends|killed]] him, despite learning that the deserter was his own clone. Fett was about to leave when he encountered the deserter's wife, asking him to spare her and her infant son. Fett informed her that he wouldn't kill them since no one paid him to do so.<ref name="BT2" />
